name: mu_yanling_sky_dancer_emblem_islands_draw
notes: Printed: '[-8]: You get an emblem with "Islands you control have '{T}: Draw a card.'"' Mu Yanling at 8 loyalty uses her -8: she goes to the graveyard at 0 loyalty, the emblem stays (CR 114.4, its abilities function in the command zone), and her controller's Island taps to draw a card. Her controller's Swamp and the opponent's Island get nothing. Before 2026-11-12 the record's GET_EMBLEM was empty: the Island had no ability (the pack fails there).
